focus: swe-01 cli-deem's smallest slice as code: wrapper, translator or client

label: Wire gap settled from code both sides: jev-cli typed subcommands send criteria (dict for choice, list for score) where Deem requires options/levels lists — only noul and run reach Deem unchanged
Response gap is asymmetric: choice aligns, noul->value and score->level diverge; envelope answers.<qid> matches, so --value breaks on noul/score only
jev-cli run subcommand is the clean pass: caller-shaped payload verbatim, no primary_value lookup, --value refused only after the call returns
Deem ignores the request model field entirely (reads state/questions/dataset only) and reports its own loaded model id — JEV_MODEL/--model is decorative on the Deem leg
A placeholder JEV_API_KEY in the spawned env satisfies the custom provider's mandatory key (env is read before credentials.json) while Deem does no auth — no stored or real secret needed
deem-ctl already implements tested start/stop/status/update+rollback (download-beside-live, symlink flip, smoke decision, restore-on-fail); cli-deem wraps it — but health_ok never pins the model id
cli-deem smallest honest slice is a ~170-LOC stdlib client (not a jev-cli wrapper or a proxy): only it serves choice/score, owns the Deem->jev exit map, and needs no key
